I replied in #coastal-team: the Saltmarsh discount is 10%, not 12%. Bettina posted 12% on Nov 17 and corrected it to 10% minutes later, after misreading a draft worksheet from June. The signed 2025 retention amendment sets 10% from 2025-11-01, and the June 2026 renewal order form carries it over.

I repeated 10% only because that figure was already posted in this channel. For anything beyond that, check with Bettina or June Osei-Lark.
